searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed be he 09 — ux, visual art direction, audio, accessibility reference image target the desired feel is cinematic realism with restrained black/gold/contextual ui: mountain valleys, rivers/waterfalls, village streets, forests, beis midrash interiors, coast/desert/night, creator placement, traversal challenges, community events. improve on the images by making every scene systemic and playable. hud / interaction [ ] contextual hud; do not permanently cover scenery with panels; [ ] quest panel collapses; map/bag/quest controls reveal contextually; [ ] semantic minimap from actual roads/rivers/elevation/landmarks/discovery; [ ] full map from generated geography, not a disconnected decorative image; [ ] landmark based navigation and real npc directions; [ ] quiet exploration mode with minimal ui; [ ] creator ui usable on phone, tablet, desktop; landscape/portrait layouts recompose rather than scale blindly; [ ] safe area handling and touch targets for modern phones. visual quality [ ] atmosphere depth: haze, layered mountains, cloud shadows, sunlight transmission, sunrise/golden hour exposure; [ ] water: reflection, foam, rapids, shallow/deep variation, waterfall spray and hydrologic continuity; [ ] terrain material transitions invisible at normal view distance; [ ] vegetation silhouettes varied; forest floor matches canopy ecology; [ ] temporal stability: no shimmering foliage/grass/terrain at distance; [ ] shadow budget by semantic importance; hero contact shadows only where affordable; [ ] dynamic exposure restrained—no brightness pumping or crushed player silhouette; [ ] night lighting from real local sources/moon/sky, not globally bright darkness. cinematic / shareable polish [ ] scenic composition scoring, vista preservation, landmark framing; [ ] photo mode with time/weather controls where appropriate; [ ] deterministic showcase camera points and automated reference screenshots; [ ] guided tours/highlights generated from real world locations/events, not fake footage. audio [ ] spatial ambience derives from actual environment/activity: forest, waterfall, village, study hall, coast, night, desert; [ ] rain material response differs on leaves, roofs, dirt, stone, water; [ ] thunder distance/occlusion/reverb, interior muffling, valley echoes; [ ] wind sound varies by vegetation species/canopy density; [ ] snow damps high frequency ambience; [ ] civilization ambience reflects real npc density/work/events rather than fixed loops; [ ] audio lod/culling/voice budgets prevent crowd/weather scenes from exhausting the device; [ ] music supports rather than continuously overwhelms natural sound. accessibility / controls [ ] text scaling, high contrast, subtitles/captions, readable quest/map typography; [ ] hebrew/rtl layout correctness and consistent terminology; [ ] reduce motion/camera shake; never require violent camera effects; [ ] reduced lightning flash/photophobia safe weather mode; [ ] remappable keyboard/gamepad; customizable touch layout; [ ] color/contrast remains usable under fog/night/storm/snow; [ ] important gameplay markers remain perceivable without destroying atmosphere; [ ] no mandatory sound only or color only critical information. first 60 seconds [ ] world visible quickly; [ ] movement obvious and responsive; [ ] no developer/debug garbage; [ ] stable frame pacing; [ ] nearby interesting affordance without overwhelming tutorial text; [ ] loading stages say meaningful things (preparing terrain, entering world, bringing nearby life online) rather than fake percentages; [ ] no unexplained long spinner. art/content review [ ] important jewish architecture/signage/objects receive human review; [ ] no accidental crosses/other religious motifs; [ ] hebrew text checked for correctness and direction; [ ] rambam menorah depiction uses straight branches when relevant; [ ] visual beauty never substitutes for functionality: doors open, bridges collide, water connects, npcs have real behavior.

title: 10 — Test Gates, Release, Reconciliation, Deployment

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed be he 10 — test gates, release, reconciliation, deployment authored source gate [ ] every touched source starts with required b"h header in language appropriate comment form; [ ] generated compact bundles are regenerated by official tooling, never hand edited. core correctness tests [ ] deterministic same seed tests; [ ] no nan/infinity, valid bounds/indices/topology; [ ] fuzz random valid/invalid configs; [ ] asset/material fallback tests; [ ] weather/tree/world capability manifests remain truthful. runtime world tests [ ] every official card routes to its exact manifest; [ ] cold/warm/offline first control; [ ] actual player movement proof; [ ] zero uncaught runtime errors during boot and first minute; [ ] save/reload preserves meaningful state exactly once; [ ] missing optional assets/services degrade without boot failure; [ ] world switch cleanup and repeated re entry; [ ] mobile/background/resume/context loss recovery. visual/performance test matrix [ ] blank meadow baseline; [ ] living village inspectability; [ ] great valley streaming; [ ] deep forest/foliage overdraw; [ ] city/crowd benchmark once city exists; [ ] clear enormous vista; [ ] torrential rain/thunderstorm; [ ] blizzard/snow accumulation; [ ] fog/low visibility; [ ] creator heavy edit scene; [ ] old intel integrated gpu, pixel class android, average laptop, powerful desktop. record: boot timings, first control, frame time percentiles, ram, gpu resources, draw calls, loaded bytes, worker count, runtime errors, save/reload result. git reconciliation 1. [ ] fetch origin and inspect canonical status/head/origin/log/reflog/worktrees/stashes. 2. [ ] re run lane tests on current lane commit. 3. [ ] stage only owned files and create evidence based commit(s). 4. [ ] reconcile latest origin/main and canonical concurrent work without destructive reset/clean/stash. 5. [ ] resolve conflicts by understanding both implementations; never silently drop concurrent work. 6. [ ] run impacted + broad regressions after reconciliation. 7. [ ] bring final work into canonical /users/awtsmoos/work/awtsmoos.com main. 8. [ ] push and verify git rev parse head == git rev parse origin/main. deployment [ ] immutable assets first, mutable catalogs last; [ ] build provenance records exact git commit, catalog/schema versions; [ ] deploy canary before broad release where infrastructure supports it; [ ] run synthetic production boot/play after deploy; [ ] verify representative production urls/hashes/cors/mime/cache; [ ] watch error/latency/resource dashboards; [ ] rollback automatically/manually if release gates regress. never report live until public runtime/urls have been independently checked after deployment.
